t: A tiny MicroPython camera board that spots objects with built-in AI.
steps: Buy the board from the OpenMV store.
Download and install the free OpenMV IDE on your computer.
Plug the board in with a USB-C cable.
Click connect in the IDE and run the hello world example to see live video.
Try the face detection or YOLO example from the examples menu.
Read the AE3 quick reference page to learn the pins and power options.
Eject the board's drive before you press reset to keep saved files safe.
